notes: #1 (Coronelli 1686) is a two-page spread with the gutter through the view and shows siege camps; skipped. #3 and #4 are portraits of Archbishop Germanos. The 1890s photochroms (#5 harbor, #6 King George Square) are good alternatives for P4 but less than 40 years from #7. #2’s Rijksmuseum date is 1679; the Swidde attribution and Visscher II imprint fit 1679–97, so the year may be a few years early. #9 sits only in a ship category but the uploader labels it Patras; layout fits. #11 (2008 rooftops) and #13 (2013 from the fortress) are P6 alternatives.
